arch.description: Only the runs whose arch filter admits this architecture, searched as the scheduler searches a worker's: the runs whose arches hold it. A run that sets no arch filter admits every architecture and is left out. No index holds the filters, so a window bounds what is read

ltc_only.description: Only the runs whose base time control is at least 40 seconds

option.description: Only the runs whose new_options or base_options set this UCI option, such as nodestime: a name matched whole and whatever its case, as UCI reads it. No index holds the options, so a window bounds what is read

page.description: The page, from 1, and 1 when absent; a page past the last holds no run

since.description: Only the runs last updated at or after this time: a UTC date, such as 2026-01-06, or a UTC time as a result writes it, such as 2026-11-20 20:48:11+00:00

success_only.description: Only the green runs: an SPRT test accepted, or a fixed-games test whose likelihood of superiority is above 95%

text.description: Words to search for in the runs' info, as the finished-runs page searches them: a run matches when it holds any of the words, whatever their case; a phrase in double quotes is matched as written, and a word after a minus excludes what holds it

until.description: Only the runs last updated before this time: a UTC date, such as 2026-01-06, or a UTC time as a result writes it, such as 2026-11-20 20:48:11+00:00

yellow_only.description: Only the yellow runs: a test rejected with more wins than losses

A string matches whole and case-sensitively, and a time is in seconds since the Unix epoch; a filter on action, username, run_id or time reads an index.
